categories.main_business_segments: Zhuhai Century Dingli Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: communication and vocational education. The communication segment focuses on wireless network optimization products, network optimization, and technical services for telecom operators, system equipment manufacturers, and terminal manufacturers. The vocational education segment provides degree education services and educational equipment sales through cooperative secondary colleges under the 'Dingli Academy' initiative, emphasizing industry-education integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced 5G and 5G-Advanced (5G-A) wireless network testing and optimization technologies, including multi-dimensional, multi-style, and multi-scenario 5G network testing instruments and data management platforms. It emphasizes independent R&D with a comprehensive product line and continuous innovation in intelligent network testing equipment. The vocational education segment integrates real industry projects into training, using a blended learning model (UBL) and digital intelligent education platforms to enhance practical skills.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic telecom operators such as China Mobile, China Telecom, China Tower, and equipment manufacturers like ZTE. The vocational education business serves higher vocational colleges and students seeking degree and skill enhancement. The company also targets emerging markets in Southeast Asia and Sri Lanka through its subsidiaries. The communication business is influenced by telecom operators' capital expenditure and procurement strategies, while vocational education focuses on stable demand from educational institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant revenue from regions including Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest China. It also has overseas operations through subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Thailand, and Sri Lanka. The company’s headquarters and main offices are located in Zhuhai, Guangdong Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Century Dingli operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the telecom supply chain, providing network testing instruments, optimization services, and integrated solutions to telecom operators and equipment manufacturers. In vocational education, it acts as a service provider and educational equipment supplier, collaborating with educational institutions to deliver training and degree programs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in 5G-A network testing and data analysis platforms, aiming to commercialize advanced 5G-A testing solutions and expand market share. It focuses on integrating AI with 5G technologies and expanding product applications beyond traditional telecom clients. In vocational education, it deepens industry-education integration, enhances digital and intelligent education ecosystems, and improves teaching quality through innovative management and real industry projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of wireless network optimization products, network optimization and technical services via bidding contracts, and vocational education services including degree program operations and educational equipment sales. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and compensation related to sold subsidiaries. Sales are predominantly direct to telecom operators, equipment manufacturers, and educational institutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Century Dingli is positioned as a leading domestic provider of mobile communication network optimization solutions and services in China. It competes with other telecom network optimization service providers and equipment manufacturers, facing increasing market concentration and competition from larger players. In vocational education, it competes in a growing but increasingly competitive market driven by policy support and industry demand for digital talent.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 281.77 million, a 22.2% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 74.4 million, though the loss narrowed significantly compared to prior years. Total assets stood at about RMB 618 million, with equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 395 million. The company’s R&D investment was about RMB 23.7 million, accounting for 8.41% of revenue. Despite losses, the company maintains ongoing operations with strategic restructuring and cost control.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Century Dingli emphasizes its independent R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines, and strong industry relationships as key differentiators in the communication sector. Its end-to-end wireless network optimization solutions and services are tailored to meet evolving 5G and 5G-A network demands. In vocational education, the company’s unique UBL blended learning model integrates real industry projects and digital platforms to enhance practical skills and employment readiness, creating a sustainable competitive advantage through quality and innovation.
